create_Counter_wrapper: create a Counter wrapper around a CompilerEnv to count calls to close, reset, step, and fork operations
review_Counter_counters: review the Counter class counters dictionary to inspect how many times each operation was called
test_Counter_step: test the Counter wrapper by calling step and verifying the step counter increments by one
test_Counter_reset: test the Counter wrapper by calling reset and verifying the reset counter increments without zeroing other counters
test_Counter_fork: test the Counter wrapper by calling fork and verifying the fork counter increments by one
